components.companion_daemon: Background service: relay dispatch, agent reconciliation, budget guard
components.relay_processor: @mention inter-agent routing with source-channel return path
components.memory_system: 4-layer memory: SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, daily logs, project Knowledge Base — synced to dashboard
components.agent_management: Create, edit, delete agents with per-agent AI model selection from web/mobile
components.cron_management: Create, edit, schedule cron jobs and automations from dashboard
components.session_monitoring: Real-time token usage, session size alerts, automatic summarization
components.project_tracking: Roadmap, task assignment to agents, progress tracking
components.budget_guard: Per-session cost limit with log/block actions

EKYBOT_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN.description: Temporary enrollment token from ekybot.com/companion (starts with ekrt_). Required only during initial setup — not stored after enrollment.

EKYBOT_APP_URL.description: EkyBot instance URL. Defaults to https://www.ekybot.com

EKYBOT_COMPANION_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Relay polling interval in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable telemetry. Default: 30000

EKYBOT_COMPANION_MAX_BUDGET_PER_SESSION_.description: Per-session cost limit in USD. When exceeded, action is taken per BUDGET_EXCEEDED_ACTION.

EKYBOT_COMPANION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED_ACTION.description: What to do when budget is exceeded: 'log' (warn only) or 'block' (reject messages).

collected: os.hostname (machine name — used for dashboard display)
process.memoryUsage (connector heap only, not system RAM)
telemetry.opt_out: Set EKYBOT_COMPANION_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=0 to disable all telemetry reporting. The companion daemon will still function for relay dispatch.
telemetry.destination: https://www.ekybot.com/api (HTTPS only, authenticated with companion token)

installation.note: All runtime files (src/, scripts/, package.json) are bundled in the skill package under runtime/. The setup script copies them to ~/.openclaw/ekybot-connector/ and runs npm install for dependencies. No git clone required.
